conversationName: Approaches to Building a Micro Society

propositions.content: Understanding different approaches to getting to a micro society is a learning goal.
A society is a community of people with collectivized resources.
Collectivization reduces time burden on individuals.
Task system is used for collectivization.
Direct democracy and consensus building are used for politics.
Centralized planning and guarantees are implemented through consensus building.
Specialized planning is used for implementation of guarantees.
Technocratic and meritocratic aspects exist in the society.
Guilds are used for skill-based training and task implementation.
AI-driven training is used for initial skill set training.
Peer training is used for actual work implementation.
Decentralized power structure exists in the guilds.
Ecological systems integration is implementation-specific.
Private spaces with shared facilities is an implementation-oriented idea.
Core concept of micro Society is a community with collectivized resources.
Definition of micro Society is crucial for implementation consideration.
Communalizing land and collectivizing resources is a promising route.
Starting with neighborhood community building is a viable approach.

Collective efficiency can be achieved by reducing individual time burden through shared systems.
Childcare can be a significant time burden for parents.
Mixed-age groups with a culture of neighborhood kids investing in each other's emotional well-being and learning outcomes can be beneficial.
